approvalMessage.text:
APPROVAL MEMORANDUM - No. 8 Chapter 441

      MEMORANDUM filed with Assembly Bill Number 8955-B, entitled:

    "AN  ACT  to  amend  the general business law, in relation to credit
        record freezes and protected minors"

    APPROVED

  This bill would allow parents and other authorized persons to  request
credit record freezes for minors in order to protect them from the harms
of  identity  theft.  As  passed,  this  bill contains certain technical
defects.  The Legislature has agreed to  remedy  these  deficiencies  by
passing additional legislation. On that basis, I am signing this bill.

  This bill is approved.                      (signed) ANDREW M. CUOMO

                                ______
